system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: Triangle with sides 8 cm, 10 cm, and 12 cm]

Which of the following triangles is similar to the triangle shown above?

Figure, described in words:
At the top is a triangle with side lengths labeled 8 cm on the left, 10 cm on the right, and 12 cm on the horizontal bottom.
Option A shows a triangle with sides labeled 12 cm on the upper-left, 10 cm on the lower-left, and 15 cm on the right vertical side.
Option B shows a triangle with sides labeled 10 cm on the left, 14 cm along the top, and 12 cm on the bottom-right.
Option C shows an obtuse triangle with sides labeled 6 cm along the horizontal bottom, 8 cm on the right, and 12 cm on the top-left.
Option D shows a triangle with sides labeled 24 cm on the left vertical side, 16 cm on the top-right, and 20 cm on the bottom-right.

A. [Image: Triangle with sides 10 cm, 12 cm, and 15 cm]
B. [Image: Triangle with sides 10 cm, 12 cm, and 14 cm]
C. [Image: Triangle with sides 6 cm, 8 cm, and 12 cm]
D. [Image: Triangle with sides 16 cm, 20 cm, and 24 cm]

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: Checking each option against the original 8:10:12 ratio (4:5:6), only option D with sides 16,20,24 scales correctly as exactly double the original triangle, so D is similar.
